units.source_text: 源氏与紫夫人并坐畅叙，光景煞是好看。

en.t: Genji sat beside Lady Murasaki and talked with her at ease, a scene that was truly lovely to behold.

units.source_text: 紫夫人此时年约廿七八岁，年纪越长，相貌越发标致。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was then about twenty-seven or twenty-eight, and the older she grew, the more beautiful her appearance became.

units.source_text: 右近离开她不多天，似乎觉得这期间她的风采又增加了。

en.t: Though Ukon had been away from her for only a few days, she felt as if Lady Murasaki's grace had increased again in that short time.

units.source_text: 右近以为玉鬘容貌美丽，不亚于紫姬。

en.t: Ukon had thought that Tamakazura was beautiful and no less lovely than Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 现在见了紫姬，恐是心情所使然，觉得紫姬毕竟与众不同。

en.t: But now that she saw Lady Murasaki again, perhaps because of her own feelings, she found Lady Murasaki after all to be unlike anyone else.

units.source_text: 两相比较，这便是幸与不幸的差别了。

en.t: Comparing the two, this was the difference between fortune and misfortune.

units.source_text: 源氏说要睡了，叫右近替他捏捏脚。

en.t: Genji said he was going to sleep and asked Ukon to massage his feet.

units.source_text: 他说：“年轻人讨厌这件事，不耐烦做。

en.t: He said, "Young people dislike this sort of thing and are too impatient to do it.

units.source_text: 年纪大的人才互相了解，亲睦得来。”

en.t: Only older people understand one another and can become close."

units.source_text: 几个青年侍女都偷偷地笑。

en.t: Several young serving women all laughed quietly to themselves.

units.source_text: 其实老爷派我们做事，谁敢讨厌？

en.t: In truth, when our lord gives us a task, who would dare dislike it?

units.source_text: 只有缠绕不休地开玩笑，我们才不耐烦呢。”

en.t: It is only when the joking goes on and on without end that we lose patience."

units.source_text: 源氏对紫姬说：“夫人看见我和年纪大的人过分亲热，恐怕也不高兴吧？”

en.t: Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "My lady, if you saw me being overly intimate with an older woman, you would probably be displeased too, would you not?"

units.source_text: 紫姬答道：“只怕不仅是开玩笑，所以我要担心。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki replied, "I worry because I fear it may not be only a joke."

units.source_text: 便和右近谈笑，姿态异常娇憨，竟有天真烂漫之相。

en.t: Then she chatted and laughed with Ukon, her manner extraordinarily charming and innocent, with an almost guileless air.
